_note: level_zoom: zoom at which a click starts to choose ADM1 and ADM2 units. The build never lets a value go below the minzoom of the boundary tiles of that level (ADM1 2, ADM2 4 at the time of writing): it prints a warning and raises it. world_zoom: below this zoom a click on the globe chooses the whole world. hidden_layers: layer_ids kept off the map from here, a temporary stand-in for display.map = false in the meta (the layer stays in the files, on /data and in the card values). fan_max: a place with more records than this opens as a list only, with no fan. default_view.country: an ISO3 code to open on a country, null for the world. type_colors: colour of a class by its value (for layers that colour by type, such as the power plants); a class not listed takes the palette by its place. point_shapes: shape of the point icons by the domain of the layer. status_styles: how a status field (or the count columns of a place) becomes a kind of icon: fill = works, pale = built but not working, hatch = under construction, outline = announced, q = shelved, x = cancelled; labels are working texts until [RES] gives the legend texts.
